tags.description: NOAA's Pacific Tsunami Warning Center serves the Pacific and Caribbean basins; responsible for 24/7 monitoring of tsunamis and earthquakes that cause them, forecasting impacts, and issuing tsunami warning messages to U.S. and the international community.
tags.name: Pacific Tsunami Warning Center
tags.note: Dec 2020 - NOAA's Pacific Tsunami Warning Center may relocated to the larger NOAA center on Ford Island in Pearl Harbor. NOAA and USGS websites both provide information that leads one to believe that they have moved and also that they have not.
